corrections.text: The article quotes GBHackers recommending administrators focus on "reviewing recent agent registrations, configuration changes, and access controls." GBHackers' actual wording is: "TeamCity administrators should also review recently registered build agents, pipeline and build-configuration modifications, Perforce integration settings, and unusual content displayed in cloud profiles."

The article quotes Cyber Security News recommending administrators "review agent registration settings, audit pipeline changes, and examine access logs." The source's exact wording is: "review TeamCity agent registration settings, audit recent pipeline changes, and examine access logs for any unusual repository or file-access activity."
